annotations.title: Audiences on a Microsoft campaign or ad group

description: The audiences (customer lists, remarketing, in-market, custom, similar, combined, product) targeted on — or EXCLUDED from — a Microsoft Advertising campaign or ad group, with each one’s bid adjustment and criterion id. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: Microsoft ad account id — omit to use the single shared account

adGroupId.description: ad group whose audience targeting to list; pass this or campaignId

campaignId.description: campaign whose audience targeting to list; pass this or adGroupId

name: list_microsoft_ads_audience_targeting
